blocks.text: LIMAY, Bataan – The Nuclear/Coal Free Bataan Movement (NCFBM) asked authorities to look into a reported fire at a stockyard of Limay Power Station in Barangay Lamao, Limay, Bataan. The fire reportedly started at 5 p.m.on Wednesday at the stockyard believed to store coal. Joshelle Magracis, a youth leader of NCFBM, posted an appeal on social media on Wednesday night, saying authorities must not wait for the situation to worsen before taking protective action.
